title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in YellowPencil…
description: A reflected Cross-site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in YellowPencil Visual CSS Style Editor up to version 7.6.7. This vulnerability arises from improper neutralization of input during web page generation, allowing an attacker to inject malicious scripts. The flaw affects versions up to and including 7.6.7. The vulnerability has a high severity with a CVSS score of 7.1.
